'''King moss''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Photosynthesis/Legends|photosynthetic]] [[Moss/Legends|moss]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. As with all mosses found on Goroth, they contained small concentrations of [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbarides]] which they absorbed from the [[Stone/Legends|rocks]] they grew on. The presence of these toxins, which were also absorbed into the creatures that preyed upon them, made the life on the planet [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] to eat for off-world species. The king moss produced [[Seed/Legends|seed]] pods, which were the favorite food of the native [[b'karr]]i. These pods were bright [[Color/Legends|yellow]], which the b'karri were attracted to. The seeds within the pods had a hard outer coating that was stripped away by the digestive juices of the b'karr. The creature would then expel the undigestible seeds which would quickly sprout and create a new colony of king moss.<ref name="Goroth" />

==Behind the scenes==
King moss was mentioned in the [[1995]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]'', written by [[Nigel D. Findley]] and published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Goroth" />
